instruction: Open the flight status page on Delta's website.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to find flights from JFK to ORD on delta.com. Successfully navigated the homepage, interacted with flight search form (typed airport codes, used autocomplete dropdowns, selected dates, changed trip type). However, flight search results page returned 'Access Denied' repeatedly. Also made form-filling errors (set ORD as both origin and destination). Used all 50 turns without completing the task.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome, dismiss cookie banners, click navigation menu items, type in form fields, use autocomplete dropdowns, interact with calendars, change dropdown selections
metadata.failure_analysis: Delta.com's flight search results page blocked automated access with 'Access Denied'. Model also confused origin/destination fields at one point, setting ORD for both.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original flight search task into navigating to the Flight Status page. The FLIGHT STATUS link is visible in delta.com's top navigation bar. This tests the model's ability to click on navigation elements without triggering the search block.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from delta.com homepage to the flight status page by clicking the FLIGHT STATUS link in the top navigation bar. Evaluator checks that the active tab URL contains 'delta.com' and 'flight-status' or 'flightstatus' using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify page navigation.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex pattern list, then matches each pattern against the URL.
Regex pattern '.*delta\.com.*flight-?status.*' correctly matches both 'flight-status' and 'flightstatus' URL variations on Delta's website.
Single-requirement instruction (navigate to flight status page) is fully covered by the URL pattern check.
No postconfig needed since URL state persists after navigation.
